honest_assessment: This is a DEAD END for acquisition. The original research premise contains a critical error: olive.com has NOTHING to do with Olive AI (the dead healthcare startup that raised $832M). Olive AI operated on oliveai.com, which now redirects to Waystar after the asset sale. olive.com is owned by Repair Ventures LLC, an ACTIVE and profitable extended car warranty company that has been in business since 2006, acquired olive.com in April 2021, and continues to operate it with active ecommerce, customer support, and ongoing press coverage as recently as 2026. The domain has ALL four registrar lock flags set (clientDeleteProhibited, clientRenewProhibited, clientTransferProhibited, clientUpdateProhibited), expires in November 2027, and is behind a Sucuri/GoDaddy security firewall. There is zero chance this domain drops, goes to auction, or becomes available for backorder. Even in the hypothetical scenario where it did become available, comparable 5-letter single-word .com domains sell for $300K-$2M, making it completely impossible to acquire within a $600 budget. The DataForSEO metrics ($2,923/mo ETV, 1,704 keywords) reflect the ACTIVE car warranty business, not residual Olive AI traffic. RECOMMENDATION: Remove olive.com from all acquisition pipelines immediately and reallocate effort to achievable targets.
